issues.detail: The Hebrew states that the Arameans of Beth-rehob and the Arameans of Zobah together numbered 20,000 foot soldiers (עֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף רַגְלִי), but the Chinese renders '二萬步兵' for Beth-rehob and '一萬人' for Zobah, splitting the 20,000 into two separate numbers (20,000 and 10,000), which changes the total and the attribution.
